dedupe_keys.name: pocet obydlenych domu dle pripojeni na kanalizaci v obcich

description: Počet obydlených domů dle připojení na kanalizaci v obcích is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Královéhradecký kraj. Data set with spatial localization of the number of inhabited houses according to the connection to the sewerage in municipalities in the territory of the Hradec Králové Region. The source of data is the Department of Regional Development, Grants and Subsidies of the Regional Authority The Hradec Králové Region. Coverage: Královéhradecký kraj. The portal shows the English title as "Number of inhabited houses by connection to sewerage in municipalities" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Královéhradecký kraj. Its keywords include Domy, Počet, Královéhradecký kraj, Kanalizace. The listing shows 6 download or service links in ZIP, KML, HTML, GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/70889546/6d065bf0aad09b7430e55705b3249aeb/distribuce/86f0fabc91809605c8cf0b750e696da4/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
